mapper.sql: select a.id, a.call_log_id, a.call_no, a.contract_id, ct.contact_no, a.contract_product_id, a.customer_id, cu.name as customer_name, a.supplier_id, s.name as supplier_name, a.supplier_account_id, sa.account_name as supplier_account_name, a.product_id, a.product_code, mp.no as model_no, a.total_tokens, a.total_fees, a.base_sell_price, a.sell_discount, a.sell_amount, a.base_cost_price, a.cost_discount, a.cost_amount, a.gross_profit, a.match_status, a.match_msg, a.call_time, a.bill_id, b.bill_no, a.usage_type, a.ref_usage_id, a.create_time, a.update_time from crm_contract_usage a left join crm_contract ct on a.contract_id = ct.id left join crm_customer cu on a.customer_id = cu.id left join crm_supplier s on a.supplier_id = s.id left join crm_supplier_account sa on a.supplier_account_id = sa.id left join crm_model_product mp on a.product_id = mp.id left join crm_contract_bill b on a.bill_id = b.id
mapper.select: select id, call_log_id, call_no, contract_id, contract_product_id, customer_id, supplier_id, supplier_account_id, product_id, product_code, total_tokens, total_fees, base_sell_price, sell_discount, sell_amount, base_cost_price, cost_discount, cost_amount, gross_profit, match_status, match_msg, call_time, bill_id, usage_type, ref_usage_id, create_time, update_time from crm_contract_usage where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into crm_contract_usage ( call_log_id, call_no, contract_id, contract_product_id, customer_id, supplier_id, supplier_account_id, product_id, product_code, total_tokens,total_fees, base_sell_price, sell_discount, sell_amount, base_cost_price, cost_discount, cost_amount, gross_profit, match_status, match_msg, call_time, bill_id, usage_type, ref_usage_id, create_time ) values ( #{callLogId}, #{callNo}, #{contractId}, #{contractProductId}, #{customerId}, #{supplierId}, ifnull(#{supplierAccountId}, 0), #{productId}, #{productCode}, ifnull(#{totalTokens}, 0), ifnull(#{totalFees}, 0), #{baseSellPrice}, #{sellDiscount}, #{sellAmount}, #{baseCostPrice}, #{costDiscount}, #{costAmount}, #{grossProfit}, #{matchStatus}, #{matchMsg}, #{callTime}, #{billId}, ifnull(#{usageType}, 0), #{refUsageId}, ifnull(#{createTime}, sysdate()) )
mapper.update: update crm_contract_usage set contract_id = #{contractId}, contract_product_id = #{contractProductId}, supplier_account_id = ifnull(#{supplierAccountId}, supplier_account_id), product_id = #{productId}, total_tokens = ifnull(#{totalTokens}, total_tokens), total_fees = ifnull(#{totalFees}, total_fees), base_sell_price = #{baseSellPrice}, sell_discount = #{sellDiscount}, sell_amount = #{sellAmount}, base_cost_price = #{baseCostPrice}, cost_discount = #{costDiscount}, cost_amount = #{costAmount}, gross_profit = #{grossProfit}, match_status = #{matchStatus}, match_msg = #{matchMsg}, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id} and bill_id is null
mapper.select: select c.id, c.bus_id, c.consumer_id, c.contact_no, c.contract_name, c.status, c.expire_time, c.sign_time, c.create_time from crm_contract c where c.deleted = 0 and c.consumer_id = #{customerId} and c.status = 2 and (c.sign_time is null or c.sign_time <= #{callTime}) and (c.expire_time is null or c.expire_time >= #{callTime}) and exists (select 1 from crm_contract_product cp where cp.contract_id = c.id and cp.deleted = 0 and cp.supplier_id = #{supplierId}) order by c.sign_time desc, c.id desc

select c.id, c.consumer_id, c.contact_no, c.contract_name, c.status, c.expire_time, c.sign_time, c.create_time from crm_contract c where c.deleted = 0 and c.consumer_id = #{customerId} and exists (select 1 from crm_contract_product cp where cp.contract_id = c.id and cp.deleted = 0 and cp.supplier_id = #{supplierId}) order by c.id desc

select id, name, no, product_code, type, source, price_detail, base_sell_price, base_cost_price, status, deleted from crm_model_product where deleted = 0 and status = 1 and (product_code = #{productCode} or ((product_code is null or product_code = '') and no = #{productCode})) order by id

select contract_id, customer_id, supplier_id, sum(total_tokens) as total_tokens, sum(sell_amount) as total_sell_amount, sum(cost_amount) as total_cost_amount, sum(gross_profit) as total_gross_profit, count(1) as usage_count from crm_contract_usage where match_status = 1 and bill_id is null and contract_id is not null and supplier_id = #{supplierId} and call_time >= #{startTime} and call_time <= #{endTime} group by contract_id, customer_id, supplier_id order by contract_id
where a.bill_id = #{billId} order by a.call_time, a.id
select distinct supplier_id from crm_contract_usage where match_status = 1 and bill_id is null and call_time >= #{startTime} and call_time <= #{endTime}
